robinhood_chain.interpretation: Still a large absolute trading venue, but the prior spot-growth regime has materially decelerated: weekly DEX growth is now negative and stablecoin growth is nearly flat. This contrasts sharply with the September 3 checkpoint, when weekly DEX volume was +96.05% and stablecoins +11.01%.

arbitrum_one.interpretation: Arbitrum One spot activity has improved, but retained stablecoin capital is still contracting, so it does not independently explain ARB's +75.5% seven-day repricing.

tokenized_stocks.notes: Robinhood Chain continues to host real tokenized-stock secondary trading with deep stock-token pools. This is not merely RWA issuance/AUM. However, chain activity remains partly contaminated by a Robinhood Wallet gas subsidy through September 29, and Robinhood Chain revenue goes to the Arbitrum DAO treasury rather than automatically to ARB holders.

why_capital_is_arriving: Tokenization/RWA narrative strengthened by the SEC's September 17 five-year tokenized-securities exemption.
Standard Chartered initiated ARB coverage on September 15 with a $10 end-2030 target and framed Arbitrum as TradFi blockchain infrastructure.
Robinhood Chain generates real licensing/treasury revenue for ArbitrumDAO and hosts material tokenized-stock secondary trading.
Broad market risk-on and short-covering conditions are amplifying altcoin momentum.

incentive_discount.notes: Robinhood Wallet subsidizes gas for qualifying swaps through September 29. Memecoin/launchpad activity and prior third-party gas promotions further contaminate raw transactions and DEX volume. Post-subsidy retention is the clean test.

wallet_quality.notes: No fresh cohort of historically selective, independently funded ARB spot accumulators was verified in this run. Stale or generic whale-flow reports are not counted as current confirmation.

value_capture.notes: ARB remains a governance token. Robinhood Chain/AEP revenue accrues to the Arbitrum DAO treasury; there is no automatic ARB holder dividend, buyback, burn or fee distribution. This preserves the September 3 model correction and prevents treating treasury revenue as holder cash flow.

supply_risk.notes: Approximately 92.6M ARB unlocks monthly through March 2027; an estimated 4.81% additional float can reach market over the next 90 days. The September 16 unlock was absorbed by price, but the recurring schedule remains an overhang.

structural_gate.notes: No honeypot/sellability or arbitrary mint/freeze failure surfaced. The gating issues are weak direct holder value capture, scheduled unlocks, incentive-contaminated activity and unverified wallet quality rather than a contract-level hard failure.

leadership_assessment: ARB is currently a price/narrative leader, not a clean capital-migration leader. Price has accelerated much faster than Robinhood Chain retained-capital/spot-growth quality. Treat the divergence as chase risk rather than confirmation.

paper_portfolio.notes: Marks are contemporaneous public spot marks collected during this run. No paper portfolio state or trade ledger mutation was made.

forward_tests: After the Robinhood Wallet gas subsidy ends September 29, require Robinhood Chain DEX activity and stablecoin balances to persist without subsidy support.
Require fresh selective-wallet ARB accumulation with funding independence rather than generic whale activity.
Require a concrete ARB-holder value-accrual mechanism or explicitly continue discounting DAO treasury revenue.
Track whether Arbitrum One stablecoin supply turns positive alongside its improving DEX activity.
Do not backdate any later trade to the current rally.
